The "Coolest" DIY project I did was I came up with a way to turn 3 hydroponic cooling fans into a Whole-House fan. It cools down our entire house within a few minutes and moves much more air than a standard one you can purchase.

Another one that I just finished was I installed a thermal reflective barrier in my attic to keep the heat out in the summer and the heat in, in the winter. You can sort of see it in this picture but basically you put down insulation, then put the barrier down, then cover it with more insulation. The barrier is perforated so that it won't cause moisture problems but it works incredibly well to reflect the heat back into the house. Before adding the barrier my furnace would turn on every 20 minutes and now it turns on about every 45 minutes. Same average outdoor temperature but at least now my wallet does not cry every time it turns on.
